monitored_text: CNC Machining Titanium Grade 5 Satin Finish Titanium Auto Parts Titanium Grade 5 (Ti 6Al-4V) is the most popular and widely used alloy in titanium CNC machining services , suited for applications that need high strength and lightweight. Other than its excellent weight-strength ratio, the biological inertia makes titanium grade 5 an ideal material for the medical industry. Ti 6Al-4V also has high corrosion resistance and can be heat treated. Junying is an experienced metal machining company that manufactures grade 5 titanium machined parts including titanium auto parts, bars, tubes, fasteners, aircraft parts, custom components, and accessories for multiple industries. A satin finish is similar to a brushed finish, a soft satin titanium parts offer a reflection of light but are different from polished parts. You can apply other finishes and colors on machined titanium. A well-equipped machine shop allows us to perform different machining processes and surface finishing operations for your CNC titanium parts to achieve the required appearance and specification, we have the capability to fabricate titanium grade 5 parts with CNC turning, milling, drilling, and precision machining.
